name: bijaku8
about: bijaku (微弱, weak) 8: curve k = 8 of the eleven of Sec. 26 (October (2026)#Y-0NbRU, Fig. 0NNbp), the case of teisatsu8, gamma_sigma = 301732/246507 g = 12.24 gamma_a (gamma_a = 0.1 g; g2(P->0) = 1.7333), on the log series P_i = 0.001 x 500^(i/24) g, i = 0..24 (0.001-0.5 g, 25 pumps, 8.9 a decade, each to 3 significant digits) (Fabrice, 15 Nov 2026: 'let's prepare a Psigma log series at small pumpings, until 0.5', 'with pilot to check convergence issues, not computing very nearby 0.3-0.4% off pumps and having 0.502 counting as 0.5; this should run together with the ongoing hokan, same priority, running in //'); the pumps of the case done already within 0.5 % stand for 1 of its points (0.5 by teisatsu8's 0.502 g); first a pilot of 1 pump (0.001 g), then the series (added by --zoen once the pilot has spoken, code/bijaku_pilot.py); code/bijaku_specs.py 1.0

parts.about: the pilot: the bottom of the series, 0.001 g, at orders 150 with weights, 200, 250, 300 and 400 at 80 digits and 300 at 160 digits: whether 150/200 (B), 250/300 (D) agree with 300/400 (E) there, and whether 80 digits hold; with hokan8's pilot pump 0.022 g and teisatsu8's pilot pump 0.502 g it sets the orders of the series (code/bijaku_pilot.py --sakusen bijaku8)

the series of bijaku8: the log series P_i = 0.001 x 500^(i/24) g, i = 0..24 (0.001-0.5 g, 25 pumps, 8.9 a decade, each to 3 significant digits), but the pilot's 0.001 g and the 1 points that pumps of the case done already stand for (0.5 by teisatsu8's 0.502 g): 23 pumps, numbered by their index i in the series, from the bottom up, at 80 digits; the orders as the pilot set them (code/bijaku_pilot.py --sakusen bijaku8): B (150w, 200) below 0.022 g, B (150w, 200) on 0.022-0.5 g; 23 pumps, 16.4 kh
